summary: Iteration 19 testing complete: Multi-provider LLM support (Groq/OpenRouter/Claude) and Bank Reconciliation module fully functional. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with provider badges, async polling, and Bank Reconciliation page with account selector, summary cards, and entry tables.

minor.issue: HTTPException was being caught by generic Exception handler and re-raised as 500 instead of 404

integration_issues.issue: Frontend used bank_unmatched/book_unmatched but API returns bank_entries/book_entries. Also matched_count/unmatched_count vs matched_bank_count/unmatched_bank_count

test_credentials: No authentication required - all endpoints are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-provider LLM support verified: Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) is primary, OpenRouter (auto) is secondary, Claude (claude-sonnet-4-5) is tertiary. Bank Reconciliation module at /bank-reconciliation with account selector (HDFC Bank - Current, Axis Bank - Current, EEFC USD Account), CSV upload, summary cards, and matched/unmatched entry tables. AI Engine uses async polling: POST /api/agents/chat returns {task_id, status:'queued'}, then poll GET /api/agents/tasks/{task_id} until complete. Provider badge shows 'Groq / Llama 3.3' on assistant messages.

multi_provider_llm.details: GET /api/agents/providers returns 3 providers with correct structure. Groq is priority 1, OpenRouter priority 2, Claude priority 3. All have 'active' status.

async_chat_architecture.details: POST /api/agents/chat returns {task_id, status:'queued'} instantly. GET /api/agents/tasks/{task_id} returns status updates. Completed tasks include 'provider' field.

bank_recon_summary_hdfc.details: GET /api/bank-recon/summary?account=HDFC Bank - Current returns book_balance, bank_balance, difference, matched_bank_count, unmatched_bank_count

bank_recon_unmatched.details: GET /api/bank-recon/unmatched?account=HDFC Bank - Current returns bank_entries and book_entries arrays

bank_recon_frontend.details: Bank Reconciliation page at /bank-reconciliation with account selector, upload button, summary cards, and entry tables

sidebar_bank_recon_link.details: Bank Reconciliation link present in sidebar under Accounting section

ai_engine_provider_badge.details: Provider badge 'Groq / Llama 3.3' visible on assistant messages

ai_engine_async_polling.details: Loading spinner visible during async processing, response appears after polling completes

rich_prompt_box.details: Paperclip button (attach-file-btn) and globe button (attach-url-btn) present in AI Engine input area
